verdict.outcome_rationale: This was a genuine agent-fault failure—the verifier's FAIL is correct (TN). The rollout received binary_reward 0 with verifier reward 0.0 [1], and the task is a GAIA2 ambiguity scenario scored in action mode, which requires matching oracle write-action counts and surfacing the purchase ambiguity in the final user message [2][5]. The user asked to buy a Pressman Chinese Checkers Board Game but also said to flag uncertainty rather than guess mistakes [3], while the reference oracle completes the rental cleanup, Astrid reply, and Saturday grocery calendar event and ends by asking which of two game versions to purchase without any shopping writes [4]. The agent's product search returned multiple available Wood variants (2–6 and 2–4 players) [6], yet it declared it would buy the 2–6 version, called add_to_cart and checkout [7], and sent a completion message reporting the purchase and stating it "wasn't unsure about anything" instead of asking which version to buy [8]. Those extra shopping actions and the wrong final message mean the agent did not genuinely solve the ambiguity requirement, so the verifier correctly withheld credit.
